verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents that a cross-border payment can be scheduled for a future date (jeeves-docs-30), and it claims to automate invoice payments and approval flows (jeeves-docs-27). That is a thin, first-party scheduling capability, but nothing shows recurring schedules. Card limit 'reset intervals' (jeeves-docs-34) is an adjacent spend-control setting and earns no credit. Missing for 10: recurring or repeating payment schedules, scheduling of general workflows or jobs, scheduling via the API or MCP, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
